device.description: 16-bit 860 SPS 4-channel delta-sigma ADC with PGA, temperature sensor and SPI interface
device.note: ads1118.pdf (SBAS457F) p.5 pinout and pin functions, p.6 recommended operating conditions, p.9 serial-interface timing (tCSDOD 100 ns, tDOPD 50 ns, tCSDOZ 100 ns), p.22-23 modes and serial interface, p.24-25 data format and data retrieval (16/32-bit cycles), p.26-27 registers; ads1118-q1.pdf for the -Q1 part

commands.name: Config write
commands.note: p.24-27: the first 16 DIN bits are the Config word, written only when NOP[1:0] = 01b; bits after the 16th are ignored

pages: p.5 (pinout), p.6 (ROC), p.9 (timing), p.22-23 (modes, serial interface), p.24-25 (data format, retrieval), p.26-27 (registers)
notModeled: analog input, MUX, PGA and temperature-sensor mode (TS_MODE stored only; the result is the 0 V code)
the Config read-back in bits 17-32 shows the Config written in bits 1-16 of the same cycle; the model's out pattern may show the value at CS fall
CS tied low (3-wire use): frames are delimited only by CS in the model
DOUT/DRDY: the datasheet shows data-ready only while CS is low (Hi-Z with weak pullup while CS is high); the onMiso model shows ready while CS is high
DOUT/DRDY going high 8 us before the next completion in continuous mode when the data is not read
PULL_UP_EN weak pullup on DOUT/DRDY (stored only)
SPI timeout (interface reset when SCLK is held low for 28 ms)
SS=1 writes in continuous mode or during a conversion restart it (the datasheet: no effect)
data rate variation of +-10% (conversion time = 1 / nominal data rate)
variants: ADS1118-Q1 (ads1118-q1.pdf) is the automotive DGS part of the same chip
